name: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc.
summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. is a life science company that develops products and brings them to market in the cosmeceutical, nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom and elsewhere. It has Active Ingredient and Pharmaceutical segments, with ingredients derived from oats such as beta glucan, oat powder, peptides, oat oil and avenanthramides.
